assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle HPV vaccines established a highly consequential means of preventing infection-associated cancer.
assessment.attribution: The listed investigators represent central mechanistic and translational contributions to the vaccine concept.
assessment.maturity: The preventive clinical impact and durability of the scientific advance are well established.
uncertainties: The relative division of credit among foundational virology, vaccine design, and clinical development remains broad.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: BCR-ABL inhibition made molecularly targeted cancer therapy a clinical reality and transformed chronic myeloid leukemia.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names cover the key therapeutic-development and clinical-validation components.
assessment.maturity: Long-term clinical benefit and the broader paradigm shift are firmly demonstrated.
uncertainties: The discovery encompasses interconnected basic, drug-development, and clinical contributions beyond three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology enabled a major therapeutic advance for diabetes and obesity with large population-level relevance.
assessment.attribution: These names capture important physiological and translational foundations of the incretin field.
assessment.maturity: The mechanism and therapeutic effectiveness have been extensively confirmed in clinical use.
uncertainties: Credit for translating incretin biology into the current drug class is distributed across discovery and industrial development.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TNF blockade established a powerful disease-modifying strategy for rheumatoid arthritis and other inflammatory diseases.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini have a focused and readily intelligible claim connecting cytokine biology to therapeutic proof.
assessment.maturity: The therapeutic principle has sustained confirmation across diseases and decades of practice.
uncertainties: The full path from TNF biology to multiple approved agents involved substantial contributions from others.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Molecular identification of the T-cell receptor provided a foundational explanation of antigen-specific cellular immunity.
assessment.attribution: The listed candidates made pivotal, partly parallel contributions to identifying and cloning the receptor.
assessment.maturity: Its central role in adaptive immunity has been repeatedly established and has enabled extensive subsequent biology.
uncertainties: Independent and contemporaneous work makes a three-person allocation difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Adult stem-cell-derived organoids created a broadly useful experimental system for tissue physiology, disease modeling, and regenerative research.
assessment.attribution: Clevers and Sato have a clear claim to the defining intestinal adult-stem-cell organoid advance.
assessment.maturity: The platform has been extensively reproduced and generalized across tissues.
uncertainties: The ultimate clinical impact of organoid-based approaches remains uneven across applications.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The cGAS-STING pathway supplied a major mechanistic link between cytosolic DNA sensing and innate inflammatory responses.
assessment.attribution: The selected names represent central work defining the pathway, though the listed record reflects a larger collaborative discovery.
assessment.maturity: Core pathway biology is well established and has stimulated broad work in infection, cancer, and autoimmunity.
uncertainties: The relative priority and credit among pathway components and contributors remain complex.
Therapeutic translation has not yet matched the maturity of the basic discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recognition of distinct B- and T-lymphocyte lineages established a central organizing principle of adaptive immunity.
assessment.attribution: Miller and Cooper are strongly associated with the complementary delineation of T- and B-cell systems.
assessment.maturity: The finding is foundational, repeatedly confirmed, and essential to modern immunology.
uncertainties: The discovery is longstanding, and its historical credit landscape includes important additional contributors.
